name: Munchi Wave
description: CHOMPI WAVE 1.0 as a Signal Chain synth: an 8-voice wavetable synth with a DJ filter, pitch and filter LFOs, delay and reverb, and WAVE's 14 factory presets. Shares tables and presets with the Munchi Wave tool.
